text:
- **Overview page:** The overview now lists open projects first. Closed projects sit in a collapsed section at the bottom. The change passed CI, and the owner closed its review request before it merged.
- **Review and feedback tools:** Work started to verify a pull request review in another repo. Work also started so agents can give feedback on the repo itself.
- **Search retrieval:** A new sprint opened to rank whole records. An offline eval harness also opened, to compare results against rg.
